proseStories.heading: ED Corner – July 2026
proseStories.originalText: Happy July, everyone! It's been an amazing summer so far of cookouts, nights spent with friends, and of course, refreshing Happy Hours to help us cool down. ... Have a great month! Yours in Service, Olivia Curavo LNHA, Executive Director

proseStories.heading: Legacy News — Picnic in the Park
proseStories.originalText: There's nothing quite like enjoying a beautiful day outdoors, and our recent Picnic in the Park was the perfect opportunity to do just that! Residents gathered together to share a delicious meal, soak up the sunshine ... Moments like these remind us that some of life's best memories are made with good food, fresh air, and great friends.

proseStories.heading: New DFS Announcement (unlabeled, interesting-and-newsworthy 1)
proseStories.originalText: We are proud to announce that Jeremiah Bates is our new DFS at GRV. He enjoys what he does, puts the residents first and his upbeat personality is contagious!

proseStories.heading: Marie's Class Reunion (unlabeled, interesting-and-newsworthy 2)
proseStories.originalText: Our resident Marie was unable to physically attend her class reunion states away but was able to attend virtually. We were honored to make her experience the very best! Members of our dietary staff Jerimiah and Jenny were given recipes from the small hometown restaurant ... We decorated the room in the school colors and mascot along with pictures from her yearbook as well as her senior picture. ...

proseStories.heading: Blast from the Past Happy Hour (unlabeled, interesting-and-newsworthy 3)
proseStories.originalText: We had amazing time jumping back into the past! Tie dye and groovy vibes were the theme! The staff and resident enjoyed making their own tie dye t-shirts and wearing them to our blast from the past happy hour.
